blocks.orig: Go on a canoe safari on one of the lakes in Arusha National Park, and take in the peace and quiet of this area in the wild. Listen to the many birds around the lake, and if you are lucky you spot hippos, giraffes, buffaloes, elephants, flamingos and other animals on the shore. An armed ranger comes along to be your guide and guarantee your safety.
blocks.html: Paddle across one of the lakes of Arusha National Park on a canoe safari and enjoy the calm and silence of this wild corner. All around the water you hear countless birds, and with a bit of luck you see giraffes, hippos, elephants, buffaloes, flamingos and other wildlife at the water's edge. You are accompanied by an armed ranger, who guides you and keeps you safe.
